stories.story_fr: La charge incrementale signee d'ici 2030 atteint 63 GW au T1 26, plus du double des 28 GW d'octobre, portee par les hyperscalers et data centers, avec 190 GW de demandes supplementaires en pipeline.
stories.story_en: Signed incremental load by 2030 reached 63 GW in Q1 26, more than double the 28 GW in October, driven by hyperscalers and data centers, with 190 GW of further requests in the pipeline.
stories.quote: New load additions expand to 63 gigawatts by 2030

stories.story_fr: AEP releve son plan d'investissement quinquennal a 78 Md$ et entrevoit plus de 10 Md$ d'investissements additionnels, soutenant une croissance de la base de tarifs de pres de 11% par an.
stories.story_en: AEP raised its five-year capital plan to $78 billion with line of sight to over $10 billion more, supporting nearly 11% annual rate-base growth.
stories.quote: Accelerating demand drives five-year capital plan to $78 billion, with line of sight to over $10 billion in additional investment anticipated

stories.story_fr: AEP exploite le plus grand reseau de transport des Etats-Unis avec plus de 2 100 miles de lignes 765 kV, et porte son investissement transport a 33 Md$, soit 42% du plan quinquennal.
stories.story_en: AEP operates the largest US transmission network with over 2,100 miles of 765-kV lines and lifted transmission investment to $33 billion, 42% of the five-year plan.
stories.quote: Total transmission investment is now expected to be $33 billion, representing 42% of the five-year capital plan.

stories.story_fr: La croissance d'AEP Texas represente 41 GW d'engagements de charge et le deploiement du Texas Senate Bill 6 doit clarifier le calendrier d'interconnexion des grandes charges.
stories.story_en: AEP Texas growth accounts for 41 GW of load commitments, and the rollout of Texas Senate Bill 6 should clarify interconnection timing for large loads.
stories.quote: Growth in AEP Texas accounts for 41 GW of new load commitments. The rollout of Texas Senate Bill 6 this summer is expected to enhance certainty around interconnection timing

stories.story_fr: AEP attend jusqu'a 16 Md$ de compensations de couts pour les clients existants sur la duree des contrats grandes charges, faisant payer aux nouveaux clients l'infrastructure necessaire.
stories.story_en: AEP expects up to $16 billion in cost offsets for existing customers over the life of large-load contracts, making new customers pay for the infrastructure they require.
stories.quote: The company expects up to $16 billion in cost offsets for existing customers realized over the life of the large load contracts.
